field.name: mi_adjusted_agi
field.comment: MI AGI after military exclusions (computed from federal AGI)

field.name: mi_exemption_married
field.comment: MI personal exemption married filing jointly - 2 x $5,800 (2025)

field.name: mi_military_retirement_exclusion
field.comment: MI military retirement exclusion (computed). 100% of military retirement pay exempt per MCL § 206.30. MOAA Grade A

field.name: mi_msrra_compliant
field.comment: MI honors MSRRA (Military Spouses Residency Relief Act). Military spouse income exempt if different domicile

field.name: mi_sbp_exclusion
field.comment: MI Survivor Benefit Plan (SBP) exclusion (computed). 100% of SBP payments exempt

field.name: mi_scra_compliant
field.comment: MI honors SCRA (Servicemembers Civil Relief Act). Active duty pay exempt if different state of residence

field.name: mi_state_tax
field.comment: MI state income tax (alias for state_tax_liability)

field.name: mi_total_exemption
field.comment: MI total personal exemptions based on filing status and dependents

field.name: mi_total_military_exclusion
field.comment: Total MI military income exclusion (computed). Sum of military retirement and SBP exclusions
